result.question: What did the king think the Arameans planned to do after leaving their camp?

readings.answer: Take them alive and enter the city.
readings.support: we will take them alive and enter the city.

assessments.reason: Verse 12 says they left the camp to hide in the field; this captures the immediate step but omits the capture-and-enter parts.
Also from verse 12; it states the later parts of the plan (take them alive and enter the city) but omits the hiding step.
